fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-07-06, Jothi Selvam was stopped by a group near Mynthan Colony Main Street, and a purse along with cash of around Rs. 8,500 were taken under threat. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-07-05 at approximately 14:00. The complaint was lodged by Deviga Murugan (9000000058) on behalf of Jothi Selvam, whose contact number is given as 9000000421. The complaint refers to Ajith Murugan, a co-worker, reachable on 9000000225. A scooter bearing the number TN-33-ZZ-1008 was seen leaving the area. The complainant alleged that Babu Krishnan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000033. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken. A scooter was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, main street, vehicle observation, afternoon, associate, suspect, scooter
